health.title: Backup health
health.description: Every backed up database and app volume, grouped by app. A backup only counts once a restore of it has been proven to work.
health.empty: No backed up resources yet. Schedule or trigger a backup from a database's or app volume's own page.
health.drillStartedDescription: It restores into a scratch resource, validates it and destroys it. Results appear in the drill history.
health.drillFailedToast: Could not start the restore drill

encryption.on: New volume backups are compressed and encrypted on this server before upload. Public key: {{key}}
encryption.off: New volume backups are compressed but not encrypted. Anyone with bucket access can read them.
encryption.keyHint: Keep a copy of the key file (APP_BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE, default backup-encryption.key in the data directory) somewhere off this server, or encrypted backups cannot be restored after a disaster.

protection.title: Bucket protection
protection.checkFailed: Could not probe the backup buckets
protection.open: Anyone with the key can delete backups

restoreWizard.title: Restore {{app}}/{{volume}}
restoreWizard.description: Restores always go into a new volume. The existing volume is never overwritten.
restoreWizard.noBackups: There is no succeeded backup of this volume to restore.
restoreWizard.sameApp: A new volume next to the original
restoreWizard.otherApp: A new volume for another app
restoreWizard.targetAppHint: The volume is named so that deploying this app mounts the restored data.
restoreWizard.summary: Restore backup {{backup}} into a new volume {{name}} on {{node}}.
restoreWizard.startedDescription: Follow progress in the restore history of this volume.

policy.title: Backup policy for {{app}}/{{volume}}
policy.description: Retention counts keep the newest backup of each of the last N days, weeks and months. Hooks run inside the app container.
policy.retentionHint: 0 turns a bucket off. Counts combine with the schedule's own keep-last and age limits.
policy.preHookHint: A non-zero exit fails the backup, so an inconsistent volume is never archived.
policy.pause: Pause the app while the archive streams
policy.pauseHint: Freezes every process in the container so files cannot change mid-archive. The app is unavailable until the upload finishes.
policy.failed: Could not save the backup policy
policy.loadFailed: Could not load the backup policy: {{error}}

drills.title: Restore drills
drills.description: Scheduled and manual restores into scratch resources. A failed drill raises the restore_drill_failed alert.
drills.empty: No drills have run yet. Drills run automatically once a week by default.

history.title: All backup attempts
history.description: Every attempt across every database and app volume, newest first.
